name: live_actor_handoff
description: Actor ownership handoff. Both peers start in Doc Mitchell's house, and the host owns Doc Mitchell (the twin shows this: there the host stays and keeps him). At 6 s the host walks to the Prospector Saloon with the bot verb `coop cell`. The guest is now the only peer in the house, so the guest must own and run Doc, and the host must give him up: exactly one peer says it owns him. The host must not mirror Doc, and the host must count one guest-owned actor. The shared hash must agree. Headless only: the viewer bot has no `coop cell` verb.
